projects.title: Public Research Abstract Processing and Analysis

bullets.text: Implemented reusable Python modules for the supervised research abstract workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Ran supplied NLTK tokenization and word-count steps on research abstract samples, then inspected vocabulary examples with guidance before attempting classification.
Under supervision, validated pandas merges with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks and used Matplotlib to visualize how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
